sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 1000. Success value 100. 10x physical damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 200% for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases buff limit for all stats by 120% for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Fire, Water, Wind, Light, Dark, Time, and Star elemental attack by 20 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases fire, water, wind, light, dark, time, and star elemental attack buff limit by 10 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Status ailment resistance value boosted by 60 for 150 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Status ailment resistance boosted by 50 when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Twilight for 150 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
Wind and Light Defense from Unison Damage +700
